headline_item.title_zh: 特朗普拟限制海外数据中心建设并征收重税
headline_item.title_en: Trump says he would block US companies from building data centers overseas or impose a "tremendous tax" on them if they do (Julianna Bragg/Axios)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 特朗普公开宣称将通过禁止或重税手段限制美国企业在海外兴建AI数据中心，以确保AI基础设施留在本土
headline_item.event_summary_en: Former President Donald Trump proposed a policy aimed at anchoring AI infrastructure within the U.S., threatening to block American companies from constructing data centers abroad or imposing heavy taxes if they do so. This policy stance follows heightened voter concern over the environmental and financial impacts of domestic data center expansion, though the legal mechanism for implementing such taxes remains unclear given Congressional oversight.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国前总统唐纳德·特朗普在美国本土及国际数字贸易政策环境：拟禁止企业海外建设数据中心或征收高额税收
【起因与机理】回应国内对数据中心能耗的担忧，试图强化AI基础设施主权
【核心事实细节】特朗普提议通过禁令或高额税收强制数据中心回流美国。
【各方立场与态度】该主张面临国会税收权限约束及全球化分布式部署商业逻辑的矛盾。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Former U.S. President Donald Trump: Proposing bans on overseas data center construction or levying heavy taxes
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Addressing domestic energy concerns and reinforcing AI infrastructure sovereignty
[Key Fact Detail] Trump proposes blocking overseas data center expansion or imposing heavy taxes.
[Key Position & Outlook] Proposal faces significant legal hurdles with Congress and contradicts the logic of distributed computing.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 该政策倾向忽视了全球分布式计算对低延迟、数据驻留合规及灾备冗余的刚性商业需求，强制回流可能导致美国科技企业在国际市场失去交付效率竞争优势。短期内此类言论更偏向政治叙事，若转化为行政指令，将引发全球云服务供应链的剧烈重组与合规成本激增。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This policy stance overlooks the commercial necessity of distributed computing for low latency, data residency compliance, and disaster recovery, potentially sacrificing the global delivery efficiency of U.S. tech firms. While currently more rhetorical, such measures would trigger massive disruption in global cloud supply chains and surging compliance costs if enacted as administrative orders.

headlines.title_zh: 黄乐关联实体涉华防军工供应链核查
headlines.title_en: Spying Suspect’s Chip Network Has Ties to Chinese Military Suppliers
headlines.event_summary_zh: 黄乐及其关联公司被指通过复杂网络获取英伟达芯片，资金流向与中国军工及国家安全部门存在高度关联
headlines.event_summary_en: Intelligence firm Strider Technologies identified that Alice Huang and her associates built a complex network utilizing $3.6 billion in Chinese government funding for data centers equipped with Nvidia AI chips. The investigation reveals that these entities maintain deep ties to Chinese military contractors and the Ministry of State Security, posing significant compliance risks regarding the diversion of restricted hardware into military research.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】黄乐（涉案人员）、英伟达（芯片供应商）、Strider Technologies（情报分析机构）：通过复杂股权网络规避制裁，获取高性能芯片并输送至涉军科研项目
【起因与机理】利用复杂企业架构掩盖资金与资源流向，以支持中国军工人工智能能力升级
【关键数据与实测】黄乐通过关联企业网络动用36亿美元政府资金投建算力中心。
【各方立场与态度】英伟达高性能芯片通过受控链条流入潜在敏感军事应用领域。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Alice Huang, Nvidia, Strider Technologies: Bypassing sanctions through shell companies to supply high-end chips for military-linked R&D
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Utilizing intricate corporate structures to mask financial flows and hardware deployment for China's AI-driven defense advancement
[Key Metrics] Huang utilized $3.6 billion in state funding through a network of shell companies to build computing centers.
[Key Position & Outlook] High-end Nvidia chips were funneled into potentially sensitive military-AI applications.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此案暴露了当前对高性能计算集群（HPC）终端用户识别的重大监管漏洞，单纯基于实体清单的管控手段在复杂股权架构面前已显得捉襟见肘。随着军民融合（MCF）深度的增加，英伟达及同类算力提供商的合规门槛将由“销售端核查”转向对数据中心算力归属的“全生命周期溯源与穿透式审计”。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This case highlights significant loopholes in verifying end-users for High-Performance Computing (HPC) clusters, proving that entity-based trade controls are insufficient against complex, opaque corporate structures. As civil-military fusion deepens, the compliance burden for Nvidia and peers will shift from point-of-sale verification to full lifecycle traceability and forensic auditing of computational resource allocation.

headlines.title_zh: METR：AI模型编程能力远超判断力
headlines.title_en: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
headlines.event_summary_zh: 人工智能评估组织METR发布报告显示，模型在编程等可验证任务上进步神速，但在决策判断类任务中表现滞后
headlines.event_summary_en: Nonprofit evaluation group METR has updated its time-horizon plot for AI capabilities, indicating that models show exponential growth in verifiable tasks like coding and mathematics, but lag in judgment-based tasks that lack automated verification. The report highlights the technological bottleneck in applying reinforcement learning to complex, open-ended research decisions, a capability critical for future autonomous R&D.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】非营利性评估组织METR更新了关于AI能力时序演进的分析框架，指出AI在编程与数学等具备明确验证逻辑的任务上表现呈指数级增长，但处理研发判断类等难以自动化量化任务的能力明显薄弱。
【关键技术规格】报告揭示了当前强化学习在处理复杂、开放性决策任务时的技术瓶颈，这类能力对于实现AI全自主研发至关重要。

【核心事实细节】A new report from the AI evaluation nonprofit METR finds that some AI capabilities are continuing to improve along an exponential trajectory—but it also indicates that models aren’t quite as good at tasks that require judgment as they are at coding.。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Nonprofit evaluation group METR has updated its time-horizon plot for AI capabilities, indicating that models show exponential growth in verifiable tasks like coding and mathematics, but lag in judgment-based tasks that lack automated verification.

[Context & Motivation] The report highlights the technological bottleneck in applying reinforcement learning to complex, open-ended research decisions, a capability critical for future autonomous R&D..

[Key Fact] A new report from the AI evaluation nonprofit METR finds that some AI capabilities are continuing to improve along an exponential trajectory—but it also indicates that models aren’t quite as good at tasks that require judgment as they are at coding.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 该突破凸显了前沿 AI 技术在垂直场景落地中的工程化深度，系统稳定性与实际生产力回报正在成为行业竞争的新标尺。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This breakthrough demonstrates accelerating engineering maturity in frontier AI, where system reliability and tangible ROI increasingly define competitive moats.

celebrity.author: Yann LeCun
celebrity.author_role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
celebrity.quote_zh:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun 正则化器只是指定归纳偏差的一种方法。

您的模型架构和您使用的优化过程已经存在归纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
celebrity.quote_en:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify an inductive bias.

The architecture of your model, and the optimization procedure you use already have inductive biases: they like to produce certain functions more than others.

A regularizer merely imposes another bias.

Learning theory tells you that you have to have an inductive bias, otherwise you can't learn anything with a reasonable number of samples or trials (VC theory, no free lunch theorems).

So, conceptually, theoretically, philosophically, and practically, there is nothing wrong with regularizers.
